name: AnchorNav
title: AnchorNav
summary: In-page links for long pages: a sticky "On this page" list beside the content on desktop, and a horizontal sticky anchor bar under the header for product pages and phones.
whenToUse: Use the side list (`.nv-otp`) on long reading pages with 4+ sections: Statement of Faith, Privacy, Terms, Cookie Policy.
Use the anchor bar (`.nv-abar`) on product pages (dot.Bible App, ISM Radio, NFC Cards) and on every long page below 1024px.
whenNotToUse: Do not use it on short pages with fewer than 4 sections.
Do not use it to switch content in place; that is Tabs. Anchor links scroll to sections that are all on the page.

anatomy.description: Lay the side list out in a two-column grid: `240px` list, `minmax(0,1fr)` content, 64px gap.

props.name: items
props.description: The sections, in page order. Maximum 8.

props.name: variant
props.description: `side` is the sticky "On this page" list for long reading pages; `bar` is the sticky horizontal bar under the header.

props.name: heading
props.description: Visible heading of the side list ("On this page"). Side variant only.

props.name: title
props.description: Product name at the start of the bar ("dot.Bible App"). Bar variant only.

props.name: action
props.description: Optional single action at the end of the bar, for example a `btn btn-primary btn-sm` link. Bar variant only.

props.name: current
props.description: Id of the active section (controlled). When omitted the active section follows the scroll position.

props.name: onCurrentChange
props.description: Called when the section in view changes.

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
Component used to render links. Defaults to `'a'`.
Pass `next/link` (or any component accepting `href`, `className`, `onClick`, `aria-current` and `children`).

props.name: scrollOffset
props.description: Height in px of the sticky offset used by the scroll spy (header plus bar).

variantNotes: **Side list item:** 40px rows, 15px `var(--gray-700)` on a 2px `var(--gray-200)` rail.
Active (the section in view): `aria-current="true"`, `var(--horizon-blue-dim)` 600 and a `var(--horizon-blue)` rail segment.

**Anchor bar:** 60px white bar, `position:sticky; top:72px`, `var(--gray-200)` bottom hairline. Links 15px/500; active is 600 with a 2px `var(--horizon-blue)` underline. Add `.nv-stuck` once it sticks to show the soft shadow.
**Anchor bar action:** optional single `.btn-primary .btn-sm` on the right ("Get the app").
**Below 1024px:** hide the side list; use the bar. Links scroll sideways, never wrap.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Set the active item from scroll position (IntersectionObserver), not on click alone.
Only one item is active at a time.
Keep labels identical to the section headings they point to.
The bar's button is the one Horizon Blue primary in that view. Leave it out when the page hero already has a blue primary in view.
Give every section `scroll-margin-top` of 96px (side list) or 140px (bar) so headings are not hidden under the sticky header.
Never use ↗ or › in anchor links; they stay on this page.

accessibility: Wrap each form in `nav aria-label="On this page"`.
Use `aria-current="true"` (not `"page"`) for the section in view.
On click, move focus to the target heading (`tabindex="-1"`) so keyboard and screen reader users land there.
Links keep at least 40px height in the list and the full 60px bar height in the bar.
content: Use the section headings: "The Scriptures", "God", "Jesus Christ", "The Holy Spirit", "Salvation", "The Church", "Last Things".
Product bars: "Overview / Features / Languages / Offline reading / FAQ".
Bar title is the product name: "dot.Bible App", "ISM Radio".
